hypothesis: Does broader natural TRAIN coverage improve the same head fitting and prevent the PC00 control collapse? Changes training population only; coverage and diversity are not separately isolated. Chunk accumulation changes finite precision only.

cohort.rule: All natural priority rows from PC00 actual fit groups, minus both controls. Original128fit rows are included; no row selected by model error.

exposure: Frozen encoder AND warm head, normalization and vocabulary previously saw controls. Held out only from NEW optimization, not untouched full-policy generalization.
model: Same actual P05 absolute/residual/logistic head, original 128D frozen M01 contexts, 39 normalized causal channels and exact int64 anchors. No new architecture/vocabulary.

training.loss: Sum normalized integer NLL over chunks divided by5876; accumulate all gradients before ONE optimizer step per update. No resampling.

assessment: All broad fit rows, original128fit rows, same two unchanged128controls. Exact,NLL,MAE,bounded candidate rank and marginalized explanation shares. Fixed final2000; no checkpoint/threshold selection, DEV lookup or promotion.
interpretation: Compare broad fitting and control changes against saved PC00. Broader population is the named treatment, not one isolated data mechanism. Diagnostic-only; no full-policy replacement. Any subsequent integrated prediction must re-decode normalized joint command probabilities.
continuation: Fresh Solxhigh review after fit; follow fitting/transfer evidence. Neither fit success nor failure establishes observation sufficiency. Original full benchmark/per-category/three-seed targets remain binding.
constraints: EligibleTRAINonly; both75-game partitions sealed. No DEV payloads, matches, downloads, bot/runtime/deployment. All old artifacts preserved.
